title: Application bootstrap & configuration
lead: Annotations that start the application and wire its infrastructure.

items.name: @SpringBootApplication
items.desc: Meta-annotation combining @Configuration, @EnableAutoConfiguration and @ComponentScan. Marks the entry point: Spring scans the com.student_manager package and auto-configures web, JPA, security, etc.

items.name: @Configuration
items.desc: Declares a class that defines beans through @Bean methods.

items.name: @Bean
items.desc: The method's return value is registered as a Spring-managed bean (e.g. the SecurityFilterChain, PasswordEncoder, CORS source, AuditorAware, OpenAPI definition).

items.name: @Value
items.desc: Injects a value from application properties, e.g. cors.allowed-origins or app.accounts.default-password.

items.name: @ConditionalOnProperty
items.desc: Registers the bean only if app.seed.demo-data=true, so demo data is opt-in.

title: Stereotypes & dependency injection
lead: Mark classes as Spring beans and define their architectural role.

items.name: @RestController
items.desc: @Controller + @ResponseBody: every method returns JSON written straight to the response body.
items.where: AuthController, CourseController, EnrollmentController, ProfileController, StudentController, TeacherController, TermController

items.name: @Service
items.desc: Business-logic layer bean (specialisation of @Component).
items.where: AuthServiceImpl, CourseServiceImpl, EnrollmentServiceImpl, ProfileServiceImpl, StudentServiceImpl, TeacherServiceImpl

items.name: @Repository
items.desc: Persistence-layer bean; enables exception translation to Spring's DataAccessException hierarchy.

items.name: @Component
items.desc: Generic Spring-managed bean found by component scanning. OwnershipGuard is named "ownershipGuard" so SpEL in @PreAuthorize can call it.

items.name: @Autowired
items.desc: Field injection of a dependency. Used only in tests; production code uses constructor injection via Lombok.
items.where: Tests: AuthControllerTest, AuthorizationRulesTest, SpringDataPatternsTest, ErrorStatusIntegrationTest, ActuatorHealthTest

title: Lombok (boilerplate generation)
lead: Compile-time code generation: no getters, constructors or loggers are written by hand.

items.name: @Getter / @Setter
items.desc: Generates getters / setters for every field.
items.where: BaseEntity, Course, Enrollment, Student, Teacher, Term, User

items.name: @Data
items.desc: Shortcut for @Getter + @Setter + @ToString + @EqualsAndHashCode + @RequiredArgsConstructor. Used on DTOs and request objects.
items.where: AuthResponse, ProfileDTO, CourseDTO, EnrollmentDTO, StudentDTO, TeacherDTO, RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, ChangePasswordRequest, UpdateProfileRequest, CreateStudentRequest, CreateTeacherRequest, CreateCourseRequest, CreateTermRequest, CreateEnrollmentRequest, UpdateGradeRequest

items.name: @NoArgsConstructor
items.desc: Generates an empty constructor — required by JPA and by Jackson when deserialising JSON.
items.where: All entities (6), all DTOs and request classes (16)

items.name: @AllArgsConstructor
items.desc: Generates a constructor taking every field.
items.where: AuthResponse, ChangePasswordRequest, LoginRequest, RegisterRequest, ProfileDTO, CourseDTO, EnrollmentDTO, StudentDTO, TeacherDTO, Course, Enrollment, Student, Teacher, Term, User

items.name: @RequiredArgsConstructor
items.desc: Generates a constructor for final fields — constructor-based dependency injection without writing it.
items.where: AuthController, CourseController, EnrollmentController, ProfileController, StudentController, TeacherController, TermController, AuthServiceImpl, CourseServiceImpl, EnrollmentServiceImpl, ProfileServiceImpl, StudentServiceImpl, TeacherServiceImpl, CrudServiceSupport, DemoDataSeeder, OwnershipGuard, SessionLogin

items.name: @Slf4j
items.desc: Adds a private static final Logger log field.
items.where: AuthController, CourseController, EnrollmentController, StudentController, TeacherController, AuthServiceImpl, CourseServiceImpl, EnrollmentServiceImpl, StudentServiceImpl, TeacherServiceImpl, DemoDataSeeder, GlobalExceptionHandler, OwnershipGuard, RequestLoggingFilter

title: JPA / Hibernate mapping
lead: Describe how Java entities map to database tables.

items.name: @Entity
items.desc: Marks a class as a persistent entity.
items.where: Course, Enrollment, Student, Teacher, Term, User

items.name: @Table
items.desc: Names the table (users, courses, terms, enrollments, students, teachers) and can declare constraints.
items.where: Course, Enrollment, Student, Teacher, Term, User

items.name: @UniqueConstraint
items.desc: Composite unique key on (student_id, course_id): a student can enrol in a course only once.

items.name: @MappedSuperclass
items.desc: A non-entity parent whose fields are inherited into each subclass table (id, audit fields, version).

items.name: @Id & @GeneratedValue
items.desc: Primary key, generated by the database (GenerationType.IDENTITY).

items.name: @Column
items.desc: Column options: nullable, unique, updatable, custom name, columnDefinition.
items.where: BaseEntity (4), Course (4), Enrollment (4), Student (4), Teacher (3), Term (3), User (5)

items.name: @Enumerated
items.desc: Stores an enum by name (EnumType.STRING) rather than ordinal — safe when enum order changes.

items.name: @ManyToOne
items.desc: Many-to-one relation, lazily fetched: Course→Term, Course→Teacher, Enrollment→Student, Enrollment→Course.

items.name: @OneToOne
items.desc: One-to-one link from the profile (Student / Teacher) to its login User.

items.name: @JoinColumn
items.desc: Names the foreign-key column (term_id, teacher_id, student_id, course_id, user_id).

items.name: @Version
items.desc: Optimistic locking: the counter increments on each update and a stale update fails instead of overwriting.

items.name: @EntityListeners
items.desc: Registers AuditingEntityListener so audit fields fill in automatically.

title: Spring Data & auditing
lead: Repository behaviour and automatic created/modified tracking.

items.name: @NoRepositoryBean
items.desc: Tells Spring Data not to create a bean for this generic interface; only its sub-interfaces are real repositories.

items.name: @Query
items.desc: Custom JPQL query. Here: lightweight projections (select new …Option(id, name, …)) for dropdown lists.

items.name: @EntityGraph
items.desc: Fetches the listed lazy associations (teacher, term, student, course) in the same query, avoiding N+1 selects.

items.name: @EnableJpaAuditing
items.desc: Turns on automatic population of audit fields.

items.name: @CreatedDate / @LastModifiedDate
items.desc: Timestamp set on insert / on every update.

items.name: @CreatedBy / @LastModifiedBy
items.desc: Username of the logged-in user (supplied by the AuditorAware bean) stored on insert / update.

items.name: @PageableDefault
items.desc: Default page size/sort for list endpoints when the client supplies none (e.g. sort by lastName, firstName).

items.name: @Transactional
items.desc: Runs the method (or all methods of the class) in one transaction. Class-level readOnly = true on services, overridden by plain @Transactional on write methods.
items.where: Class-level: CourseServiceImpl, EnrollmentServiceImpl, ProfileServiceImpl, StudentServiceImpl, TeacherServiceImpl. Method-level: AccountProvisioner, AuthServiceImpl, CrudServiceSupport (3), DemoDataSeeder, TermController (2) and the write methods of the services.

items.name: @RequestMapping
items.desc: Base path of a controller (e.g. /api/students).
items.where: AuthController, CourseController, EnrollmentController, ProfileController, StudentController, TeacherController, TermController

items.name: @GetMapping
items.desc: Handles HTTP GET (reads/lists).
items.where: AuthController, ProfileController, TermController, CourseController (4), EnrollmentController (4), StudentController (4), TeacherController (4)

items.name: @PostMapping
items.desc: Handles HTTP POST (create, login, register).
items.where: AuthController (2), CourseController, EnrollmentController, StudentController, TeacherController, TermController

items.name: @PutMapping
items.desc: Handles HTTP PUT (full update).

items.name: @PatchMapping
items.desc: Handles HTTP PATCH (partial change: grade, cancel, acknowledge, etc.).

items.name: @DeleteMapping
items.desc: Handles HTTP DELETE.

items.name: @RequestBody
items.desc: Deserialises the JSON body into a Java object.
items.where: All controllers that accept input (AuthController, CourseController, EnrollmentController, ProfileController, StudentController, TeacherController, TermController)

items.name: @PathVariable
items.desc: Binds a URL segment such as /{id} to a parameter.

items.name: @RequestParam
items.desc: Binds a query parameter (filters like ?search=).

items.name: @RestControllerAdvice
items.desc: Global interception point for exceptions thrown by any controller.

items.name: @ExceptionHandler
items.desc: Maps one exception type to an HTTP response. 11 handlers: not-found, invalid credentials, validation, bad body, type mismatch, access denied, optimistic lock, integrity violation, bad sort property, fallback.

title: Bean validation (Jakarta Validation)
lead: Declarative checks on incoming request objects, triggered by @Valid. Patterns are centralised in ValidationPatterns.

items.name: @Valid
items.desc: Triggers validation of the request body; failures raise MethodArgumentNotValidException → HTTP 400.
items.where: AuthController (2), CourseController (2), EnrollmentController (2), ProfileController (2), StudentController (2), TeacherController (2), TermController

items.name: @NotBlank
items.desc: String must not be null, empty or whitespace.
items.where: RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, ChangePasswordRequest, UpdateProfileRequest, CreateStudentRequest, CreateTeacherRequest, CreateCourseRequest, CreateTermRequest

items.name: @NotNull
items.desc: Value must be present (used for roles, ids, grade).

items.name: @Pattern
items.desc: Regular-expression check (username, password policy, names, course code, matriculation number).
items.where: RegisterRequest, ChangePasswordRequest, UpdateProfileRequest, CreateStudentRequest, CreateTeacherRequest, CreateCourseRequest

items.name: @Email
items.desc: Must be a syntactically valid e-mail address.

items.name: @Size
items.desc: Length limit (term name ≤ 100).

items.name: @Min / @Max
items.desc: Numeric bounds (credit hours 1–10).

items.name: @EnableWebSecurity
items.desc: Activates the web security filter chain (session login, CSRF, CORS, HSTS, URL rules).

items.name: @EnableMethodSecurity
items.desc: Enables method-level annotations such as @PreAuthorize.

items.name: @PreAuthorize
items.desc: SpEL expression evaluated before the method runs, e.g. @ownershipGuard.canManageCourse(#id, authentication); denial → 403.

items.name: @Override
items.desc: Compiler-checked marker that a method implements an interface or overrides a superclass method.
items.where: AuthServiceImpl, CourseServiceImpl, CourseRepository, EnrollmentServiceImpl, EnrollmentRepository, ProfileServiceImpl, StudentServiceImpl, TeacherServiceImpl, DemoDataSeeder, RequestLoggingFilter, SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler

items.name: @SpringBootTest
items.desc: Boots the full application context for integration tests.
items.where: StudentManagerApplicationTests, ActuatorHealthTest, AuthControllerTest, AuthorizationRulesTest, ErrorStatusIntegrationTest, SpringDataPatternsTest

items.name: @AutoConfigureMockMvc
items.desc: Provides a MockMvc client to call controllers without a real server.

items.name: @Transactional
items.desc: In tests, rolls back each test's database changes automatically.

items.name: @ExtendWith
items.desc: Registers an extension — here MockitoExtension, which initialises the mocks.
items.where: AccountProvisionerTest, CourseServiceImplTest, DemoDataSeederTest, EnrollmentServiceImplTest, ProfileServiceImplTest, StudentServiceImplTest, TeacherServiceImplTest

items.name: @Mock
items.desc: Creates a fake dependency (repositories, encoders…).
items.where: AccountProvisionerTest, CourseServiceImplTest, DemoDataSeederTest (7), EnrollmentServiceImplTest, ProfileServiceImplTest, StudentServiceImplTest, TeacherServiceImplTest

items.name: @InjectMocks
items.desc: Creates the class under test and injects the mocks into it.
items.where: CourseServiceImplTest, DemoDataSeederTest, EnrollmentServiceImplTest, ProfileServiceImplTest, StudentServiceImplTest, TeacherServiceImplTest

items.name: @Test
items.desc: Marks a test method (142 in total).

items.name: @ParameterizedTest & @ValueSource
items.desc: Runs one test several times with different literal inputs (regex validation cases).

items.name: @BeforeEach
items.desc: Runs before every test method (set-up).
items.where: AccountProvisionerTest, CourseServiceImplTest, EnrollmentServiceImplTest, ProfileServiceImplTest, StudentServiceImplTest, TeacherServiceImplTest

items.name: @BeforeAll / @AfterAll
items.desc: Run once before / after all tests in the class.
